name: Farce Yuuwaku Hakusho
original_name: ファルス 誘惑白書
source:
Tachioki Izumi holds a detective office with his childhood friend as his assistant. They get an unusual request that will shed light on the mystery of the dragon tribe descendant residence.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
立置泉经营着一家侦探事务所，青梅竹马则担任他的助手。两人接到一项不同寻常的委托，它将揭开龙族后裔宅邸之谜。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/07/vn-of-month-december-1994.html]vndbreview[/url]]
